Description: This 16-bit register sets the block size for I/O block operations for each function (1-7). If this card does not support I/O block operations (SMB=0), then this register becomes read-only and shall always read 0000h. The maximum block size is 2048 (0800h) and the minimum is 1 (0001h). At power-up or reset, this register shall be initially loaded with a value of 0000h. The host is responsible for setting the appropriate value for the block size supported by each function. This pointer is stored in little-endian format (LSB first).
